response.overview: Shakuntala is an emotional family drama that explores love, identity, and the weight of tradition. Born into a conservative household bound by rigid customs, Shakuntala defies her family’s expectations by marrying a man from a Christian family in their neighborhood. Her decision, rooted in love, is seen as a betrayal of their deeply held beliefs, leading to her complete estrangement from her family. Years pass in silence, with wounds left unhealed. When her father passes away due to old age, Shakuntala is denied the right to return home or even attend his funeral. The grief of losing him, combined with the pain of rejection, leaves her torn between dignity and longing.
response.title: Shakuntala
